scope: Source repair packet and dependency-free contract tests, not native RoboMME or VLA evaluation
primary_claim: The proposed repair preserves one target across fixture configuration, task predicates, planner and language goal, and rejects defined identity/time/input violations in contract tests.
research_claim_status: HOLD; selector subset transfer and VLA effects untested
estimator: Deterministic assertions and adversarial contract cases only; no learned estimator, selector or policy inference

environment.name: VideoUnmask
environment.checkpoint_boundary: Not needed for source/contract tests; actual checkpoint, encoder and normalizer mandatory before model integration

fixture.identity_rule: Group identifies fixed scene; permutation/attempt/view are children. Planned IDs are not collected episodes.

policy_visible_input.scope: Semantic contract checker only; actual model tensor capture unimplemented

action_option_set: Native future path: 7 Panda joint targets plus gripper. Contract tests: symbolic container identity only, never reported as robot actions.
decision_timing: First policy decision after demo/cue ends, before any policy action; post-step row i must pair with action i+1 only when consecutive steps and provenance are known.

memory.mask_rule: Do not renumber slots/positions; same-count irrelevant-frame control; at least one valid token; no future index.

metric.primary_future_research_outcome: Native task success; not measured in N3
metric.auxiliary: First exclusive approach-region commitment, not first correct selection or grasp success
metric.rules: Commit once before any bin lift. Multiple region matches are ambiguous; lift before commitment is unobserved_before_lift; terminal without commitment is no_commitment. Keep these outcomes in denominator.
metric.validity: Thresholds are frozen design choices, not validated selection labels. Native planner traces must validate utility before use; otherwise drop auxiliary metric without changing success metric.

baseline_fairness: All three permutations share seed, scene configuration and fixed red goal; tests permute target through every bin. Native scene/current-observation equality still requires rendering/physics.
cost_unit: Contract test count and container wall seconds only; not sample efficiency, GPU-hours or policy success
reject_revise: A failed contract case blocks source packet qualification.
Static patch/application and mocked task binding do not satisfy native rendering, planner, model or research gates.
Do not auto-start the 72-episode N1 proposal or train a selector.
If paired pre-action observations differ after native qualification, revise/drop fixture before policy comparison.
